redfin.remarks: Proudly introducing this modern 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo offering 1,257 sq ft of stylish living space plus an incredible flex area great for a den, home office, or potential 3rd bedroom. As you enter, experience the spacious open layout highlighted by newer luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout. The inviting living room features a modern fireplace and sliding glass doors that lead out to a private enclosed patio , creating the perfect indoor/outdoor flow for relaxing or entertaining. The updated kitchen has been beautifully modernized with quartz countertops , stainless steel appliances , and recessed lighting. Privately situated in its own wing of the condo, the spacious primary suite offers a peaceful retreat complete with an ensuite bathroom featuring a standalone shower and sleek modern finishes. The secondary bedroom is generously sized with great natural light and is conveniently located near the main bathroom featuring dual sinks, bathtub/ shower combo. Additional highlights include in-unit washer and dryer, side-by-side parking, and extra storage room within the building. HOA amenities include a sauna, bike storage, fitness area and the HOA carries earthquake insurance. Ideally located moments from Wilshire Blvd, Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s, highly rated Lincoln Middle School, the Santa Monica Promenade, Santa Monica Pier and beach, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, coastal living and an excellent flow of ocean breeze!
